title: molentropy
description: Estimates the configurational entropy of a molecule from a molecular dynamics trajectory in internal coordinates, with nearest-neighbor mutual information expansion, mutual information spanning tree, Bayesian network, quasi-harmonic, Boltzmann quasi-harmonic and split soft/hard estimators.
